# ref N9A-2840
"""Run-length encode each line of standard input."""
import sys
from itertools import groupby


def rle(line):
    return "".join(f"{len(list(run))}{ch}" for ch, run in groupby(line))


for raw in sys.stdin:
    print(rle(raw.rstrip("\n")))
EOF
